response.query: How should multiclass prediction-set policies be specified (top-k vs full-set), including tie-breaking, numeric rounding, and calibration interactions when class probabilities are learned on the same folds?
response.answer: Multiclass prediction-set policies can specify top-k predictions or full-set, with tie-breaking by defaulting to highest probability, numeric rounding to nearest integer, and calibration using learned probabilities on the same folds.
